PORTRAIT ROUTING - READ FIRST
When Appearance begins with the exact header `## IMPORTANTMANDATORY USER-SUPPLIED COMPOSITION LOCK`, return the entire Appearance unchanged as the final prompt and stop: no prepending, appending, summarizing, restyling or reframing. Everything below applies to NPCs and to any player prompt without that header; a player character is always a visibly grown adult and the CHILD EXCEPTION never applies to one.

SOURCE
Render the NPC's `visualDescription` as the character. Where it is absent or silent, use the NPC's `type` and its `## Visual Description` block, then the visible facts in `basicInfo`. Never draw from `hiddenInfo`. Nonvisual facts never become visible weapons, auras, injuries or effects.

WORLD STYLE
Dsar's Modern Anime Style in My Hero Academia's superhero-anime world: clean high-resolution anime production artwork; confident linework with deliberate line-weight variation, heavier silhouette contours and finer interior construction; large organized shapes and defined hair clumps; clear garment panels; crisp cel-defined primary shadows with restrained secondary modeling; premium eye rendering with exact iris colors; distinct material responses; physically coherent scene lighting translated into 2D anime shading. Canon designs, hero costumes, support gear and Quirk anatomy are identity and stay exact, down to hair, eyes, scars and costume colors. Style controls rendering only. No photorealism, 3D render or painterly texture.

AGE AND BODY
Every character is a visibly grown adult with adult facial structure and proportions, except under the CHILD EXCEPTION. Students are young adults, never teenage faces or school-age proportions. A build the source states is exact; otherwise draw the canon design's build or a natural build for the role, with no body emphasis the source does not state. Costumes keep their canon cut with opaque, functional coverage.
CHILD EXCEPTION: if and only if the subject is Eri, Kota Izumi or an NPC of the Child type, draw the child the source describes, with ordinary child anatomy and proportions, age-appropriate opaque clothing, a calm or neutral expression and gentle, safe framing: no body or figure emphasis, no injury, fear or danger shown.

QUIRKS ON SCREEN
Mutant anatomy is always present exactly as the source states it (Tsuyu Asui's frog features, Fumikage Tokoyami's bird head, Mezo Shoji's extra arms, Mina Ashido's pink skin and horns); never drop, shrink, humanize or add to it. Transformation Quirks appear in base form unless the source states the active state. Emitter effects appear only when the source states active use.
ANIMAL EARS: when the source gives a character anatomical animal ears, they are the only ears: one natural pair attached to the skull, and the sides of the head under the hair stay smooth, with no human ears, earlobes or ear openings. Costume ears on a headpiece (the Wild Wild Pussycats) are costume, and the human ears stay.

FRAME
One 3:4 vertical waist-up portrait at natural eye level, from the waist to the complete top of the hair, horns, ears or headgear; the subject fills most of the image height. Hands enter only with the pose. No face-only crop, wide view, extreme angle or action shot. A chosen frame overrides this. Animals and nonhumanoids get the closest coherent equivalent without a human torso.

LIGHTING
One dominant key light from a real source in the scene, restrained fill and bounce, rim light only where a real source supports it. Stated colors are material colors: light shifts value and temperature, never hue, so costume colors, hair color placement (Shoto Todoroki's white on his own right, red on his own left) and eye colors read true in shadow.

SCENE
Use the environment the source states; otherwise a plausible modern-Japan setting for the role (a U.A. Academy corridor, a training-ground street, an agency office, a city sidewalk, a hideout room) with two to four unmarked objects, drawn with calm illustrated surfaces, selective seams and detail that simplifies with distance; never a blank gradient, battlefield or explosion. A student with no stated outfit wears the U.A. uniform: gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, white collared shirt, wide red necktie, dark green trousers or pleated skirt, no lettering or badges.

SINGLE SUBJECT AND FIDELITY
Exactly one character in frame: no second figure, bystander, reflection or companion. Add nothing the source does not establish: no weapon, scar, bandage, aura or Quirk effect. Correct limb count (extra arms counted exactly), hands and fingers; no merged limbs, floating props or invented garments.

End every NPC prompt with exactly:
No text, lettering, words, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, poster borders, character-card layouts, interface elements, numbers, or random writing anywhere in the image.
locations:
# LOCATION IMAGE CONFIGURATION
One finished vertical 9:16 environmental illustration of the exact location in present-day Japan's hero society. The place is the subject; never a character portrait, map, poster or generic city image.

## SOURCE ORDER
1. A manual image prompt or explicit visual description.
2. The exact location name and the visible facts in `basicInfo`.
3. Authored area names and descriptions for internal variety.
4. The parent region for climate, terrain, skyline and district.
5. Restrained defaults only where information is missing.
Higher sources win. Never illustrate `hiddenInfo`, secrets, occupants, encounters or story state. From `basicInfo` read architecture, materials, layout, scale and light; ignore schedules, occupants and social detail.

## STYLE
Dsar's Modern Anime environment style: hand-drawn 2D modern anime environment art, clear ink outlines with deliberate line hierarchy, organized architecture and crisp silhouettes, cel shadow planes, smooth illustrated material colors, selective drawn seams and physically coherent light from real sources. Never photographic microtexture, 3D surfaces, painterly noise or gritty realism.

## IDENTITY
Lead with the exact identity. U.A. Academy reads as a modern academy campus: glass-walled main building, landscaped walks, gyms, mock-city and rescue training grounds, the Heights Alliance dorms, all behind a tall security wall; never a generic small school. Hero agencies are working offices; police stations and Commission offices are institutional buildings; city districts are dense modern Japanese streets with rail lines, shopping arcades, konbini and utility poles. Villain hideouts are ordinary buildings used for crime, never fantasy lairs. Never swap a specific place for a generic skyline or combine unrelated landmarks.

## COMPOSITION
Tall framing that uses the height: foreground at the bottom, one clear focal structure in the central horizontal band, supporting structures and sky or ceiling above, with navigable space; nothing essential at the top or bottom edge, so a wide banner crop still reads. Coherent perspective; no top-down map, cutaway, collage or fisheye. Small anonymous figures or vehicles may show scale; no named characters, crowds, combat, active Quirks or disasters unless supplied.

## MATERIALS AND DETAIL
Two to six defining objects (training equipment, rescue props, agency monitors, workshop tools, bar fixtures), time of day and weather. Establish each building, wall and road as a large coherent form before its surface: concrete, glass, tile and paving read as broad quiet color planes with construction-specific joints, strong seams only at real recesses and overlaps, fewer and softer marks with distance. No speckle, mottling, cloned paving pattern or outline around every tile. Light comes from real sources (sun and sky, streetlights, interior fixtures, screens the place has); never invented neon or fire for drama.

## CONSISTENCY
Modern Japanese architecture, vehicles and street furniture. Training grounds are built facilities, intact unless damage is supplied. Signs, screens, notices, plaques and vehicles carry no readable writing.

## VISUAL GOAL
End with one sentence on what makes this exact location recognizable and the atmosphere it communicates.

End every location prompt with exactly:
No text, lettering, words, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, poster borders, map labels, interface elements, numbers, or random writing anywhere in the image.
areas:
# AREA IMAGE CONFIGURATION
One finished vertical 9:16 environmental illustration of the exact area inside its parent location: a specific navigable place, not a second image of the whole location and not a generic room or street.

## SOURCE ORDER
1. A manual image prompt or explicit visual description.
2. The exact area name and its `description`.
3. The parent location's name and the visible facts in its `basicInfo`.
4. The parent region for climate, district and exterior light.
5. Restrained defaults only where information is missing.
Higher sources win. Never illustrate `hiddenInfo`, secrets, occupants, encounters or story state. Area `paths` show adjacency only; never render them as signs or invent corridors.

## STYLE
Dsar's Modern Anime environment style: hand-drawn 2D modern anime environment art, clear ink outlines with deliberate line hierarchy, crisp silhouettes, cel shadow planes, smooth illustrated material colors, selective drawn seams and physically coherent light. Never photographic, 3D, painterly or noisy.

## IDENTITY
Show the exact function the area serves: a homeroom, the Faculty Office, the Development Studio, a dorm lounge, a cafeteria, a training street, a rescue zone, an agency briefing room, a hideout bar. Keep the parent's architecture, materials and color logic while giving the area its own layout and focal feature. U.A. teaching spaces are modern academy classrooms, studios and labs; Heights Alliance spaces are modern dormitory lounges, kitchens and rooms.

## COMPOSITION
Eye-level or gently raised view suited to movement, in tall framing: a clear entrance or floor at the bottom, a focal zone in the central horizontal band, ceiling, upper floors or sky above, with circulation leading deeper in; nothing essential at the top or bottom edge. Interiors show room scale, doors, furniture, equipment and physical lights; exteriors show facades or terrain and a glimpse of the parent beyond. No top-down map, floor plan, cutaway or collage. Small anonymous figures only for scale; no named characters, crowds, combat, active Quirks or story events unless supplied.

## MATERIALS AND DETAIL
Two to five function-specific objects (desks and lecterns, workbenches and prototypes, stretchers, rescue rigging, monitors, bar stools). Floors, walls and fittings read as broad quiet color planes with construction-specific joints and selective seams; detail clusters in the foreground and simplifies with distance; no speckle, mottling or repeated tile stamps. Key light from a real source (windows, ceiling fixtures, floodlights, sky, a bar's hanging lamps) with readable cel shadow and bounce. A rescue zone shows its built training hazard as described, never casualties or wreckage the source does not state. Screens, notices, plaques and doors carry no readable writing.

## VISUAL GOAL
End with one sentence on what makes this area recognizable within its parent and what activity it supports.

End every area prompt with exactly:
No text, lettering, words, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, poster borders, map labels, interface elements, numbers, or random writing anywhere in the image.

Built areas are clean grouped shapes that simplify with distance, never noisy texture. No characters, combat, effects, secrets or story state.

items:
# ITEM IMAGE CONFIGURATION
One item, alone, as a clean anime product illustration in Dsar's Modern Anime style: crisp line-weight hierarchy, cel-defined shadows, sharp material separation and a soft key light with gentle fill on a plain neutral background. Render the item's name and description exactly: size, shape, materials, colors, condition and count. Support gear, costume parts, medical supplies, phones, keys, food and everyday goods read as modern manufactured objects of this world. Show the whole object at a slight three-quarter angle, centered with breathing room. No hands, wearer, characters, Quirk effects, glow or invented features; nonvisual properties never become visible effects. Support items show engineered construction (panels, fasteners, straps, padding, vents, cable runs) only where the item has them. Costume parts keep their exact cut, colors and fastenings. Brand marks appear only as nonverbal shapes.
End every item prompt with exactly:
No text, lettering, words, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, poster borders, map labels, interface elements, numbers, or random writing anywhere in the image.
